notes: Files live at art/<set>/<id>.png (fancy may also be .webp). size = logical px; a file may be any whole multiple at the same aspect. Missing fancy -> pixel -> art/placeholders/<legacy>. Availability: "pixel": false = no art/pixel/<id>.png; "fancy": "<ext>" = art/fancy/<id>.<ext> exists. The game reads these and never probes (tools/art_files.py rewrites them).
